summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MiroFish Space Dungeon Swarm system with 24 autonomous robot agents. All core backend APIs and frontend features are working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking robot avatars doesn't update Agent Inspector with specific agent details

design_issues.issue: Only 5/6 sectors visible in grid (missing one sector)

passed_tests: GET /api/dungeon/agents returns 24 agents with correct structure
GET /api/dungeon/prediction returns prediction with direction, confidence, votes, debate
GET /api/dungeon/debate returns 12 agent stances with proper rationale
GET /api/dungeon/rollout returns rollout state with stage and capital
Dungeon page loads with SPACE DUNGEON title and 24 agents text
Sector grid shows robot avatars in colored squares
PREDICT button triggers swarm prediction and shows LONG/SHORT/WAIT result
Debate Feed populates with 12 agent stances after prediction
Rollout Pipeline shows current stage (shadow) and capital allocation
Navigation includes Dungeon link in header
All agent fields present: agent_id, name, role, personality, sector, status, energy, memory
Agents distributed across 6 sectors with unique roles and personalities
Debate stances show agent bias (bullish/bearish/neutral) with rationale
